content:
tvOS 27 is the latest system update for Apple TV 4K, and the rollout to all users begins today. Here is an introduction to the new features of tvOS 27.

tvOS 27 brings a redesigned Apple Podcasts app, new Apple Music features, customisable text size, and several other changes.

tvOS 27 can be installed via the Settings app on Apple TV. All Apple TV 4K models except the first generation can be updated, while the Apple TV HD is not supported.

The tvOS 27 update from Apple includes the following features and changes:

Podcasts: The Apple Podcasts app on Apple TV receives a major overhaul, following the design language from the iOS redesign earlier this year. The brand-new tvOS Podcasts app fully supports Apple's video features, making it easier to watch video podcasts. The interface also adopts a fresh design with a sidebar navigation for a smoother experience.

Update via iPhone: tvOS 27 adds a handy new feature that lets you update your Apple TV 4K system directly from your iPhone. Through the Home app on iOS 27, you can install tvOS 27 and future updates without even turning on the TV.

Apple Music upgrade: tvOS 27 brings two new features to Apple Music. AutoMix comes to Apple TV, offering DJ-style song transitions — perfect for parties. Support for Hi-Res Lossless audio is also added, but it requires a compatible external speaker output.

Larger text: You can adjust the overall system font size via the Dynamic Type option in the Settings app, making it easier to read on the sofa across different viewing environments.

Finally, Apple says tvOS 27 supports faster AirPlay connections, smoother animations, quicker app launch times, and a more responsive Control Centre.

Features not making an appearance: Siri AI and Smart Downloads

It is worth noting that tvOS 27 does not include the new Siri AI assistant — only the older Siri is available. Reports suggest this is because the upcoming next-generation Apple TV 4K will feature more powerful hardware required to support Siri AI.

Another missing feature is Smart Downloads, mentioned by Apple at WWDC. Since tvOS has never supported downloading TV content, the announcement came as a surprise. Smart Downloads may refer to certain system-related functions rather than TV shows or films. Either way, the feature is nowhere to be found in the tvOS 27 beta.

Have you installed tvOS 27 yet? How has the experience been? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
